note: What a server sends to open a surrender vote, or to report one already open. The header names no object: it carries zero.

bits.name: countAsYes
bits.note: Read only where side is the client's own: set shows caller voting yes, clear voting no, opening the menu or not.

bits.name: openTheMenu
bits.note: Set where the vote opens: a client of side opens the vote's panel from seats and closesIn, which nothing else reads; every client is told a vote began, with caller, inFavour, against and side.

bits.name: unused
bits.note: A client does not read these.

fields.name: caller
fields.note: The unit that called the vote.

fields.name: closesIn
fields.note: How long the vote stays open, in seconds.

revisions.note: A client ignores it unless its menu and its own champion both exist.

bits.name: countAsYes
bits.note: Set where the receiving seat is taken to have voted for. Set in everything observed.

bits.name: openTheMenu
bits.note: Set where the client shows the vote to the seat. Set in everything observed.

fields.name: caller
fields.note: The unit that called the vote.

fields.name: closesIn
fields.note: How long the vote stays open, in seconds.
